SELECT LEVEL, C.ONETALK_NO, C.ONETALK_CONTENT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE < 1/24/60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전' WHEN SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE < 1/24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전' WHEN SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - C.WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전' ELSE TO_CHAR(C.WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS ONETALK_WRITE_DATE,
C.MEMBER_NO, C.MEMBER_NAME, C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO, C.ONETALK_DEL_FL, C.WORKER_NICKNAME, C.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, C.BUSINESS_NAME FROM ( SELECT O.ONETALK_NO, O.ONETALK_CONTENT, O.ONETALK_WRITE_DATE AS WRITE_DATE, O.MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_NAME, O.PARENT_ONETALK_NO, O.ONETALK_DEL_FL, W.WORKER_NICKNAME, E.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, E.BUSINESS_NAME FROM "ONETALK" O LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "WORKER" W ON O.MEMBER_NO = W.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" E ON O.MEMBER_NO = E.MEMBER_NO ) C WHERE C.ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N' AND ( C.BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR C.BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.ONETALK_NO AND SUB.COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N' ) ) START WITH C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR C.ONETALK_NO = C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.ONETALK_NO DESC
